name: Bernalda (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Bernalda (a white ox beneath three stars on green) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Bernalda, a comune in Basilicata; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Bernalda arms — white ox beneath three stars on green, crowned, within branches
